svg.aria-label: Figure 6-1. Loading graph for the test machine, a Mac with 24 GB installed. As found the game needed 44 to 59 GB of memory, at 3 to 6 frames per second. With winegrid and the patched MoltenVK it needs 26 to 33 GB, at 10 to 30. With the squeezer 24 GB stays in memory and 10 to 13 GB of data the game never touches again sits in swap, at 16 to 53.
